answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 196457 Country: USA Title: Not helping in the past and repenting for it Question: When I was younger, I had a water bottle and was traveling. This little boy came up to me asking for my water, but since I wasn’t thinking at the time, I didn’t give him it. Now, I feel really guilty about it for not providing him with water that he could’ve desperately needed. I have repented many times, but I am scared that by not giving him the water, he could’ve got ill or something like that. I feel super guilty about not helping him. Will I be forgiven? What will happen to me if something bad happened to him once I didn’t give him the water, even if I didn’t mean to purposefully hurt him? I feel so bad just thinking about it, for not giving help. Please note that this was in another country, and I don’t know what to do. Answer ID: 196457 Posted on: May 6, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 10078/1343/M=11/1446) If this incident occurred in your childhood, there is no need to overthink it or lose hope in Allah’s mercy. However, it is a positive sign that you feel remorse and regret. If it is no longer possible to contact or meet the boy, it is best to pray for his well-being and give charity on his behalf. In the future, whenever someone needs help, assist him to the best of your ability. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
